title: introduce-workload-coalescer-with-dynamic-priority-reshaper-and-slice-telemetry-export
text:
introduce-workload-coalescer-with-dynamic-priority-reshaper-and-slice-telemetry-export

description:
Motivation: small-sequence micro-batching causes high per-request overhead and uneven tail behavior for mixed-length workloads. This PR adds a lightweight Workload Coalescer and a Dynamic Priority Reshaper that: 1) opportunistically groups short, compatible requests into transient micro-batches to improve GPU utilization without violating latency SLOs; 2) dynamically reshuffles queue priorities based on recent per-route latency budgets and in-flight KV cache warmth; and 3) exposes a slice-aware telemetry exporter that emits p50/p95/p99 by coalesced-slice and attributes token-level KV cache hits to originating requests. The patch includes: a concurrency-safe coalescer component with pluggable admission policy, a reshaper that consumes SLO signals from the runtime telemetry bus, a synthetic micro-bench suite to validate SLO preservation under various mixes, and a compact exporter that augments existing bench histograms with per-slice metadata for easier root-cause analysis. Checklist: - [x] design doc and sequence diagrams (internal link ENG-3112) - [x] unit + integration tests for coalescer admission logic - [x] perf harness and deterministic replay scenarios - [x] telemetry tests and exporters wired to bench pipeline - [x] manual canary on staging (2 nodes) - [x] docs/benchmarks entry explaining knobs and metrics Notes: This intentionally favors a conservative default admission window (12ms) to avoid tail amplification; policy parameters are tunable via bench config. The description below lists commits, changed areas, review thread highlights, CI summary, and merge details.

commit_summary:
a1b3f2a: implement base WorkloadCoalescer with admission window and time/size heuristics
b4c2d11: add DynamicPriorityReshaper that subscribes to runtime SLO bus and recomputes queue weights
c7f9e5d: slice-aware telemetry exporter and bench histogram enrichments
d2e8a90: deterministic synthetic runner for mixed-length workloads and reproducible seeds
e5a1b77: unit and integration tests for coalescer and reshaper; add docs/benchmarks/guide.md

review_comments:
Miguel Ortega: Overall looks good. Two concerns: 1) ensure admission window doesn't starve long sequences when load is high; 2) we need a KV-cache priming invariant for coalesced batches. Can you add a short section in the design doc?
Asha Patel: Added a priming invariant section in docs/benchmarks/guide.md and a test that simulates cold KV cache to verify we do not regress tail latency under cold starts. Admission window is conservative by default; rewiring to SLO bus allows runtime tuning.
Jun Park: Please add explicit metrics for dropped/deflected requests by the reshaper and ensure the exporter labels include route and coalescer_slice_id. Also squash the small telemetry refactor commits.
Asha Patel: Added dropped_request counter and coalescer_slice_id label; rebased and squashed telemetry refactor into the exporter commit.

merge_details:
Merged by Jun Park via squash-merge after 2 approvals. Merge commit includes deterministic runner and telemetry exporter changes. Canary run validated no p99 regressions on staging for the default config. Backport not required.

release_notes:
Introduce Workload Coalescer and Dynamic Priority Reshaper to improve utilization for mixed-length workloads and add slice-aware telemetry exports. Default admission window is conservative; enable via bench config. Includes new metrics: bench.coalescer.slice_latency_ms (p50/p95/p99), bench.coalescer.dropped_requests, bench.reshaper.queue_weight.
